brand_identity.name: Clara Campaigns
brand_identity.tagline: Professional Office 365 Email Marketing & Newsletter Intelligence
brand_identity.vibe: High-precision corporate SaaS, sleek dark navigation with crisp high-contrast light content area, refined micro-interactions and tactile drag-and-drop editor interface

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200

app_shell.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar with dark theme (#0F172A), collapsible, displaying Clara Campaigns logo, main nav links (Dashboard, Campaigns, Newsletter Builder, Contacts/CSV, Office365 Integration, Analytics, Settings), connected O365 account status indicator, user avatar, and logout with MFA badge.
app_shell.header: Top header with sticky navigation, active route title, search bar, send test campaign quick action, Office365 sync status button, and TOTP MFA security indicator badge.
app_shell.main_container: Fluid container with generous padding (p-6 to p-8), max-w-7xl mx-auto, light gray background (#F8FAFC).

login_mfa_flow.description: Two-step authentication flow inspired by clr.koodh.com login.
login_mfa_flow.step_1: Email & Password login with Microsoft 365 OAuth direct sign-in button.
login_mfa_flow.step_2: TOTP Authenticator app code verification screen with 6-digit numeric input boxes, resend/recovery options, and 'Remember this device' option.

newsletter_builder.layout: 3-column layout (Block Drawer on Left col-span-3, Interactive Drag/Drop & Visual Canvas in Center col-span-6, Block Properties & HTML Editor Toggle on Right col-span-3).
predefined_blocks: Title Header Block (H1, H2, H3 customization)
Body Text Block (Rich text with formatting toolbar)
Image Block (Image URL, alt text, link URL, width)
Button CTA Block (Button text, link URL, background color, text color, corner radius)
Divider & Spacer Blocks (Height, line style, color)
newsletter_builder.dual_mode: Seamless toggle between Visual Drag-and-Drop Mode and Raw HTML Editor Mode with syntax highlighting and live iframe preview.

contact_list_management.csv_import_modal: Drag-and-drop CSV file dropzone, column mapping preview table (Email, First Name, Last Name, Company, Tags), duplicate email resolution handling (skip/overwrite), and progress status bar.
contact_list_management.table_view: Dense, clean table listing contacts, email validity status, open rate, click count, tag pills, search filter, and bulk actions.

office365_integration.status_card: Connection status card showing connected Office365 tenant, sender email address, OAuth token expiry state, re-authenticate button, and test connection action.

campaign_analytics.kpi_cards: Total Sent, Total Opened (Open Rate %), Total Clicked (Click-Through Rate %), Bounce / Unsubscribe Rate.
campaign_analytics.charts: Recharts visual charts for Opens/Clicks over time, Top Clicked Links breakdown table, and Recipient Click Log with timestamp, contact name, email, and specific link clicked.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or rounded-lg styling, explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-indigo-700), active states, and active focus rings. Primary buttons use indigo (#4F46E5), secondary buttons use outline with backdrop blur.
component_guidelines.cards: White background, border border-slate-200, rounded-xl, subtle shadow-sm, hover:shadow-md transition-shadow.
component_guidelines.inputs_and_selects: Use Shadcn customized components with data-testid on every field. No raw transparent dropdowns or unstyled native select.
component_guidelines.toasts: Sonner toast notifications for action confirmations (e.g. 'Campaign Scheduled', 'CSV Imported Successfully', 'O365 Connected').

motion_and_interactions.animations: Staggered fade-in on dashboard load, smooth block drag-and-drop feedback with subtle shadow lift, smooth mode transitions between HTML and Visual builder.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: All frontend components are in React JS (.js files, NOT .tsx). Do not write TypeScript type annotations in .js files.

Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, table row, and modal contains explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='create-campaign-button', data-testid='csv-import-dropzone', data-testid='totp-mfa-input').

Reference the layout style of clr.koodh.com: clear dark left sidebar navigation with branding header, structured white content cards with light gray background, crisp status badges, and prominent MFA/O365 status indicator.
Implement the complete drag-and-drop newsletter editor with preset blocks (Title, Body text, Logo, Image, Button, Divider) and raw HTML editor mode toggle.
Ensure Sonner toast notifications are triggered for important user actions (e.g. sending campaigns, saving templates, CSV contacts import, MFA verification).
Do not center-align the entire app container. Maintain left-aligned readable grid structures with generous padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop aesthetics. Use crisp dark navigation paired with high-contrast light content surfaces.
No transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, headers, or overlays.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Use specific CSS transitions (e.g., transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease), never transition: all.
Custom scrollbars only; do not create layout shifting.
